texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Tell us about a small but meaningful obj: The most meaningful object in my workspace is a small always-on desktop machine that runs my multi-machine Claude agent fleet. It is nothing photogenic - a plain box that never sleeps - but while I am on calls or asleep it keeps my CRM enriched, my 10-year knowledge base indexed, and 100+ automation routines running. I check its heartbeat every morning the way other people check the news. It matters to me because it is quiet, humming proof that one person plus well-run machines can do the work of a team - and a daily reminder that reliability is something you build and verify, not something you assume.
